decisions.reason: Adding fiat-mint payment methods and removing the wallet prerequisite does not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, visibility, allocation, or enforcement.
The existing message-143 INTRODUCE already records the required FAQ explanation that Transak supports cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay without requiring existing crypto or a wallet.
The supported fiat payment methods do not alter the $15 mint price or the founder, referral, and prize-pool allocations.
The fiat payment-method decision does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, winners, or pool-funding sources.
Allowing wallet-free fiat minting does not change badge milestones, storage, presentation, or effects.
The fiat payment-method decision does not change Big Block prize parameters, eligible sales, draw triggering, or funding.
Payment methods and the fiat buyer's wallet prerequisite do not change the required NFT metadata counters, badges, or mint-number referral attribute.
The Transak payment options do not alter ticket weighting, winner eligibility, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain selection.
The fiat-mint payment decision does not resume, remove, or otherwise change the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
Wallet-free fiat minting does not change the manual one-click prize claim flow on the Winners page.
Supporting additional fiat payment methods does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, resets, or secondary-sale ticket rules.
Not requiring crypto or a wallet for fiat minting does not eliminate or modify email magic-link authentication for dashboard access.
